name: breadcrumbs
purpose: Agent-operations machinery for a repo you cannot afford to break: memory ledgers, retrieval measurement, CI guards, merge-gate workflows, and the pattern docs behind them.
distribution_note: There is deliberately no pip/npm package. Every file is meant to be copied into your repo, owned, and edited; a package would make our release cadence your dependency and fight the adapt step. This manifest exists so a developer or their agent can adopt programmatically anyway: resolve a problem to artifacts, copy them, run their selftests.

requires.python: >=3.9, stdlib only (no dependencies anywhere in the kit)
requires.platform_assumptions: git repo; GitHub Actions for the workflow templates; Claude Code for the command/hook templates (adapt for other harnesses)

verify_all: Run every selftest below; each is offline, stdlib-only, and exits nonzero on failure. CI runs the same set (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

artifacts.what: Retrieval exam over a conclusions ledger: reachability verdicts, injection lane probe, use-stamp readout, forbidden-hit check (a superseded value must not win retrieval), ratchetable baseline, and a no-ledger survey mode for any repo.
artifacts.assumes: CONCLUSIONS.jsonl schema (see templates/CONCLUSIONS_TEMPLATE.md); survey mode assumes only markdown and a boot file.

artifacts.what: Three-tier runnable memory: working state, append-only episodes with stable provenance handles, and semantic facts that can cite their source episodes. Facts name their asserting actor and authority; verification requires evidence plus a distinct tool or human verifier, while agent authority and self-verification are refused. Compaction flushes down before shrinking; overwrites log the prior value as a supersession episode first; rejected values leave tombstones that block silent re-assertion; deterministic retrieval fuses lexical, action/tag, and recency ranks; build_context takes an as-of cutoff (learned-at replay), a valid-at moment (world-time windows), and an audience (public/internal/regulated scope filter at assembly; the unscoped episodic tier is omitted under any audience).
artifacts.assumes: Local filesystem; single operator.

artifacts.what: Trusted-principal authorization seam for memory context: the host resolves the current principal, immutable policy derives its clearance, ungranted identities fail closed, and request input cannot assert or widen audience.
artifacts.assumes: Sibling memory_engine.py and a host-owned PrincipalProvider backed by an authenticated session or workload identity; stdlib only.

artifacts.what: Golden-query regression exam for the runnable memory engine: expected hits, forbidden hits, deterministic fusion, scope exclusion, learned-time replay, world-time validity, and verification-time masking.
artifacts.assumes: Sibling memory_engine.py and a JSON corpus shaped like memory_engine_golden.json; stdlib only.

artifacts.what: Governed offline replay: deterministically selects high-signal, repeated, and recent episodes, validates an external evaluator into a typed fact, skill, watch, correction, or unknown proposal, counterfactually rehearses proposals against expected and forbidden outcomes, and appends stable review-only proposals without changing memory.
artifacts.assumes: episodes.jsonl written by templates/ledger-tools/memory_engine.py; stdlib only; evaluator supplied by the adopter.

artifacts.what: Append-only learning cycles that distinguish sourced knowledge, application or teach-back, externally evaluated understanding, novel-context transfer, and review-only mastery proposals.
artifacts.assumes: External tool or human evaluators; stdlib only; no automatic memory mutation or skill activation.

artifacts.what: Staleness auditor: classifies every ledger entry STALE / AGING / SPECIAL / OK against the live tree and checks supersession chains.
artifacts.assumes: CONCLUSIONS.jsonl schema.

artifacts.what: Pre-push collision check: behind-base, cross-branch file overlap, placeholder commit subjects, repeated base merges, stale session-state handoffs. A check that cannot run reports SKIPPED, never PASSED.
artifacts.assumes: git; other-branch data supplied as plain JSON.

artifacts.what: UserPromptSubmit hook injecting a same-turn capture reminder when a prompt contains ruling-shaped language.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code hooks; register per templates/ledger-tools/capture-nudge.md.

artifacts.what: Lint guards (PII in fixtures, provenance narration, magic limits, raw view DDL, inline style/script, env vars outside config, unsourced authority citations, boot-set line budgets) each shipped with fixtures proving it bites.
artifacts.assumes: Python repo conventions vary per guard; each guard's docstring states its own.

artifacts.what: Forward-only migration runner with an applied-state ledger and policy checks, with tests.
artifacts.assumes: Numbered SQL migration files; adapt the runner's paths.

artifacts.what: GitHub Actions templates around a fail-closed merge gate: automerge with an approval label, greenlight helpers, staging reset, branch auto-update, plus the gotchas doc that cost real debugging time.
artifacts.assumes: GitHub Actions; branch protection on the default branch.

artifacts.what: The rules-file skeleton: integrity floor, conventions, decision capture, continuity check, retro, writing rules. This repo's own CLAUDE.md is one filled-in instance.
artifacts.assumes: Any agent harness that loads a rules file.

artifacts.what: The append-only conclusions ledger format: path-keyed one-line JSON entries with evidence, provenance fields, and the dated supersession grammar.
artifacts.assumes: Nothing beyond a text editor; the ledger tools read this schema.

artifacts.what: Slash-command definitions (scout, retro, checkpoint, promote, ship, model-check, and more), each a workflow your agent runs on demand.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code commands; adapt frontmatter for other harnesses.

artifacts.what: Harness-side hooks: pre-compact save, post-compact pointer, outbound PII screen, batch cadence, model routing.
artifacts.assumes: Claude Code hook events; each file names its own event.

artifacts.what: The standing-agent fleet kit: registry, boot packs, routine prompts, wake routing, the summon protocol, and the a2a task bus pattern.
artifacts.assumes: Scheduled agent runs (cron or platform routines); multi-session operation.

artifacts.what: In-process test harness skeleton for route-level tests without a server.
artifacts.assumes: Python web app; adapt app_example.py.

artifacts.what: Paste-able rule sets for a rules file: session efficiency, data truth, flag lifecycle, regression layering, forward-only migrations, reuse-first, delivery protocol, propose-confirm-execute, adoption verifier.
artifacts.assumes: Each file states its own assumptions in its header.

artifacts.what: Operational checklists: continuity sweep, PR discipline, pre-push.
artifacts.assumes: Nothing.

artifacts.what: Pattern essays: the reasoning behind each artifact (memory measurement, floating memory, the chorus, context budgets, decision capture, the airport model, and more). Essays describe patterns; what ships is stated per essay.
artifacts.assumes: Nothing.

artifacts.what: How the pieces fit together: the operating model, coordinator seat model, scheduled agents, the unattended-agent contract.
artifacts.assumes: Multi-session operation.

artifacts.what: Diff-tiered merge gate policy: docs-class changes merge on green with no label, everything else (and every deletion or rename) waits for the human approval label. Fail closed; the automerge workflow runs the base branch's copy.
artifacts.assumes: the fail-closed automerge workflow in the same directory; adapt SAFE_PREFIXES to your repo

artifacts.what: Parses the boot-set budget table, counts lines in every file it lists, and fails the build on anything over budget or budgeted-but-missing. --report prints per-file headroom so a shrink can be ratcheted in the same PR.
artifacts.assumes: a markdown budget table with File and budget_lines columns (CONTEXT_BUDGET.md); stdlib only

artifacts.what: Context-budget raises as loans: every cap raise files a record with why, a trim target, a trim trigger, and a reassess date; a due loan is a red check and an unrecorded raise fails the gate.
artifacts.assumes: a budget manifest of always-loaded files and their line caps (CONTEXT_BUDGET.md in this repo, shape in docs/context-budget.md); stdlib only

artifacts.what: Evidence-scoped readiness calculator for agents and repositories: unknown dimensions reduce coverage without becoming failures, every scored claim cites evidence, and public-ready states require owner opt-in and human review.
artifacts.assumes: Python 3.9+; a JSON assessment assembled from public or explicitly permitted evidence; stdlib only.

artifacts.what: Attaches a publication-approved Breadcrumb Score pointer to an A2A Agent Card as a non-required extension while refusing private endpoints, unknown public fields, stale evidence, and mutation of signed cards.
artifacts.assumes: A2A 1.0 public Agent Card and a published Breadcrumb Score assessment; Python 3.9+ standard library only.

artifacts.what: Public synthetic matched evaluation of unstructured history versus Breadcrumbs cue packets, scored by exact orientation fields with accuracy, token use, latency, and errors reported separately.
artifacts.assumes: Python 3.9+ standard library only; optional Hugging Face inference uses the sibling runner, a local HF_TOKEN, current model IDs, and execution-time confirmation for potentially billable calls.
